insight: Began converting stranded natural gas into compute for Bitcoin mining; sold that business to NYDIG in 2025 to focus entirely on AI.
name: Crusoe
tagline: Energy-first AI cloud and gigawatt-scale AI data centers.
description: Vertically integrated AI infrastructure company: Crusoe Cloud offers NVIDIA and AMD GPU clusters with managed Kubernetes and managed inference, while its data-center arm develops and powers gigawatt-scale 'AI factories' — including OpenAI's 1.2 GW Stargate campus in Abilene, Texas, which Crusoe built and co-owns.

modelSupport.notes: GPU cloud runs any model or framework; Crusoe Managed Inference layers on top.

edge: Builds and powers its own data centers — energy-first siting brings capacity online without waiting on utility grid constraints.
pros: Owns power generation and data centers end to end
NVIDIA GB200/B200 and AMD MI300-class GPUs
cons: Pricing is sales-led rather than self-serve

references.title: Crusoe Adds 4.5 GW Natural Gas to Fuel AI, Expands Abilene to 1.2 GW
